messages:
maya: Heads up — after the canary deploy I'm seeing severe chart stutter when opening a workspace that contains map tiles + timeseries. Main thread parse spikes on initial paint. Flame attached.
felix: Which canary? any quick repro steps? :eyes:
sam: @maya can you paste the waterfall? I also noticed some browsers falling back from OffscreenCanvas to main-thread canvas which could explain layout jank.
maya: quick dump of headers & flag we saw in canary:\n```\nGET /static/vendor-telemetry.js 200\naccept: */*\nuser-agent: Mozilla/5.0\nX-Telemetry-Sample: 1\nfeature.rollout.sampleTelemetry=true\n```\nthis telemetry-client v3 change flipped sampling on by default for the canary group.
zehra: Looks like two correlated problems: the telemetry client and its sourcemap ballooned the vendor chunk (~1.8MB gzipped -> bigger parse cost), and on some Safari versions OffscreenCanvas is not available so we fall back synchronously. Both together cause the 1–2s parse+layout hit.
deploy-bot: deploy canary recorded: 2026-01-31T12:04:23Z -> telemetry-client:v3 rolled to 20% traffic.
felix: Measured in lab: initial load main-thread parse went from ~600ms to ~1.9s when maps are present. Stack shows `console-loader.js` spending time parsing vendor/telemetry mappings.
sam: Mitigations to try: (a) defer telemetry client init until after firstInteraction or idle, (b) lazy-init OffscreenCanvas/worker and polyfill detection, (c) split the telemetry client into its own chunk via splitChunks so the big sourcemap isn't on the critical path.
maya: I'll open a rollback PR for canary and a patch to defer telemetry init. Filing tickets: ENG-PLAT-719 (rollback), ENG-PLAT-720 (defer telemetry init), ENG-PLAT-721 (split vendor telemetry). @sam can you take the worker prototype for OffscreenCanvas?
sam: :thumbsup: taking ENG-PLAT-721 — will prototype worker init and post a short demo by EOD.
